Title: As Good As My Word
Description: Find Ranger Heo Do-yun's previous associates. Once found, let them know Heo Do-yun is still alive.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugNothingicando" />I had the "good fortune" to be off scouting when the Corrupted struck.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_beckonLarger" />Please look for any surviving rangers. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />It would be heartening to know I wasn't the only survivor, this time.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_beckonLarger" />You have the look of someone who has good news!<g id="female_leanforwardListen" /> I take it others survived the attack?

Title: Mapping The Edge Of Despair
Description: Find the best locations to map out enemy camps in northern Great Cleave. Then bring your notes back to Ranger Heo Do-yun.
PlayerPrompt: "Is that why you are still here?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_headNodYes" />Yes. I was sent to map the supply lines of the Corrupted. <g id="male_gestureAhead" />With you here, we could cover more ground.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />We need accurate maps if we are to track what the Corrupted are up to. <g id="male_fistpumpRight" />Each piece of new information brings us closer to victory!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_salute2finger" />You, my friend, are an extremely competent mapmaker. <g id="male_spreadhands" />I know it couldn't have been easy to write in the cold, <g id="male_nodProud" />but this linework is excellent!

Title: Picking Up The Pieces
Description: Recover weapons and armor from Ranger Heo Do-yun's fallen companions. Recover Mardea's Shield, Hanu's Spear, Topalian's Helm, and Kaipo's Axe.
PlayerPrompt: "How do you plan on honoring them?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />When we build a new bastion, I plan on putting their prized weapons and armor on display <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" />so that we never forget their sacrifices.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />Their warrior spirits will live on forever, <g id="male_explain" />but those of us who didn't fall would be reminded about their strength and courage if we had something to remember them by.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Mardea's Shield, as good at absorbing blows as she was hardship. <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />Hanu's quick wit, as sharp as the spear she fought with.

Title: The Balemaw Beast
Description: Find the notorious Balemaw Beast which has been preying on travelers in the region.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_smackfist" />The Balemaw Beast is taller than a person and covered in fur! <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />It has glowing eyes that pierce through the snow and claws as long as daggers.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Have you discovered any clues to the whereabouts of the Balemaw Beast?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: From your expression you have discovered something… <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Please let it not be another body. Tell me truthfully, I can handle the worst.

Title: Wolves Of Winter
Description: Track the beasts that have been attacking travelers to their lair and defeat them.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />The color of the eyes, along with their ability to manipulate ice, leads me to believe that these creatures aren't natural.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Have you checked the nearby ice caves? What about the ones farther away? <g id="female_crossarms" priority="high" />We have to be sure they aren't spreading.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_salute2finger" />You look like you've been in quite a fight. <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Was it with the Yeti? Have you banished it?

Title: The Beast Returns
Description: The Balemaw Beast struck again! Track the beast up Mangled Heights and defeat it!
PlayerPrompt: "Do I need to check on Bob again?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />It wouldn't hurt. <g id="female_crossarms" />Though I can't imagine Bob has a hand in this, unless we were vastly mistaken about the nature of his character.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />These are dark days indeed if such beasts wander the land.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Has it been taken care of? Has the beast been destroyed?

Title: A Spot Of Luxury
Description: Gather beautiful Spotted Pelts from Bobcats to add to Rue Horne's collection.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_salute2finger" />I could tell you were one with a fine eye for fashion. <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Really, your outfit, superb! I couldn't design something better myself.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />I must have those spotted pelts! Do hurry back soon!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_headnodding" />You found me, good! With you helping to procure the bobcat pelts…

Title: Fabulous Furs
Description: Gather fantastically colored pelts from local cougars and elk to add to Rue Horne's collection.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_quidproquo" />More than unusual, they are extremely profitable! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Those hues will mean I save a fortune on dyes!
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_clenchfistsGetpumped01" />Those colors! They make me weak just thinking about them! <g id="female_beckon" priority="high" />I must have them!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_leanbackCovermouth" />Oh. My. They are even better in person than from afar. Oh, and so soft. So supple.

Title: Pure Delight
Description: Gather brilliant Pure White Pelts from wolves to add to Rue Horne's collection.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_leanforwardListen" />Your concern is touching. <g id="male_explain" />But trust me, anyone buying pure white pelts are not worried about how to keep them clean!
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />Those pelts are a blank slate just waiting to be gobbled up by fashion.<g id="female_gestureForward01" /> Do be hasty in bringing them back!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_leanbackCovermouth" />Oh, what a wonder! Imagine enfolding yourself in these furs! <g id="male_spreadarms001" />Why, you'd sink into them and give up wearing anything else.

Title: White As Bone
Description: Collect Ancient Ivory for Valta so she can add it to a poppet.
PlayerPrompt: "But I have seen no children here."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I have not seen children either, but I have listened long to tales older than this island. And I am certain there is a way.
InProgressResponse: I need bones of the Ancients to make this work.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: These bones, so old, and yet they have not faded away.

Title: Red As Blood
Description: Collect blood red Firebright Rubies from the mine for Valta so she can add them to a poppet.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I tried dyes before, sadly they all failed. This time I shall try rubies, blood red in color. They don’t fade with time, always staying bright.
InProgressResponse: I need bright shining rubies to make this spell work. I tried blood and dye before, but those didn't last long enough.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: How deep their color, like blood that has been caught and frozen in time.

Title: Black As Ebony
Description: Collect night black pieces of Charred Ebony for Valta so she can add them to a poppet.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I have heard rumors that someone brought ebony furniture to one of the forts. You could search there and see what you could find.
InProgressResponse: All I require now are charred pieces of ebony. Soon, my child soon, you shall know peace in my arms.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Perfect, perfect. The bones are inside, with rubies for the heart and eyes, and charred pieces of ebony to hold it all together.

Title: An Offering For Offspring
Description: Travel to the Wishing Tree and leave the Poppet as an offering so that Valta may one day have a child of her own.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I don't know. What I do know is that none of my previous offerings worked. The poppet of snow and blood and ash barely lasted a day before it melted away.
InProgressResponse: Please take the poppet to the Wishing Tree. I can hear the voice of my child even now.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Something is different, I can feel it. The air has a hint of warmth to it. The wind holds fewer sighs.

Title: Perfect Piroshkis
Description: Gather Dried Dill, Crumbly Aged Cheese, and Tenderized Meat for Aksinya.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Tell me about it! Why, I haven't had new deliveries in quite some time, and it shows.
InProgressResponse: What I wouldn't give for some spices, cheese… anything to brighten the potatoes and onions I already have on hand.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You did it! I almost can't believe it, it's been so long since I've seen something other than potatoes to eat! Tell me I'm not dreaming.

Title: To Warm The Soul Warden
Description: Bring Piping-Hot Piroshkis to Soulwarden Pedro Carrillo at Warden's Rise before they get cold!
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I've already made food for everyone stationed here, and I want to spread the bounty around.
InProgressResponse: Off with you! You don't want those piroshkis to get cold, do you?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: That smells wonderful! Marvelous! I haven't had any food that smelled this good for… I don't remember how long! What's the occasion?

Title: Ice Chronicles
Description: Find Kazu, the owner of the journal. Maybe he can teach you more about the glyphs in Aeternum.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Could the glyphs reveal how the Ancient Guardians are powered? Could this knowledge be useful for our fight against Corruption? I must continue my search and list every glyph I find.
InProgressResponse: Could the glyphs reveal how the Ancient Guardians are powered? Could this knowledge be useful for our fight against Corruption? I must continue my search and list every glyph I find.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Is this really my journal? The leather cover, the embossed kanji. The words I'll never see-

Title: Glyph Of The Wolf
Description: Kazu turned blind when he tried to activate the strange new glyph. Help him research a similar one at Mokosh Springs.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Then you shall be of great help, my friend. Be careful. Do not touch the glyph or you may suffer a fate similar to mine.
InProgressResponse: Did you find the symbol?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Yoku dekita! You have proved yourself a valuable ally today. Did you really see an ice wolf near this glyph too?

Title: The Curse That Goes Round
Description: Break the curse that has Simone going around in circles.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_explain" />My day keeps looping in on itself. I wake up, I walk a few meters. <g id="male_dontknow" />I lose consciousness.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_listenforward" />Did you find the curse my aunt placed upon me? Did you remove it? <g id="female_beckonLarger" />Please, tell me you removed it!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_dontknow" />Well? What cursed thing did my aunt leave in my bag? <g id="male_explain" />There must be a cross, tied leaves, a potion? At the very least, a note?

Title: A Passing Good Knight
Description: Assist an aged and possibly delusional knight with his plan to impress the Soulwardens.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_salute2finger" />Hail, ser. <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />I am a worthy knight, come from afar in search of the Soulwardens.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_outfitproud" />With our forces combined, we shall prevail against the Corrupted!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_outfitproud" />By my troth, that was well fought. You have truly earned that most noble of titles: <g id="male_saluteFistToChest" />a passing good knight.

Title: Armed At All Points
Description: Defeat the Siege Engineers at Riven Anvil.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_gestureForward01" />Let us take measure of these plans. Hmm.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_explain" />‘Siege Engineers’ are building weapons of war nearby. We must defeat them so the evil never comes to pass.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_clenchfistsSuffer" />That... was the stuff of legends. The Soulwardens are safe… for now.

Title: Battle Wounds Bestow Honor
Description: Alas and alack! As Sir Hotspur lays stricken, accept the mantle and report to the Soulwardens.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_clenchfistsSuffer" />Those fiends gave me such a buffet that I can’t even stand. <g id="female_clenchfistsSuffer" />It vexes me to stay behind, but the Soulwardens must be made known of the evil designs against them.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_clutchhead01" />Find the map buried in a grave. It shall lead you to the Soulwardens. Warn them of the dire threat against them.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />Did that odd-talking old fool put you up to this, the one with all the armor? <g id="male_listenforward" priority="high" />Well, perhaps not such a old fool after all.

Title: Orbs of Power
Description: Gypsum Kilns are used to create powerful items. Find Gypsum then learn the ways of the kiln.
